editor.tab.unsavedChanges.description: Read out by screen readers after the name of an editor tab whose form has changes that haven't been saved; a dot shows it on screen

editor.tag.custom.description: In the last column of the editor's tables of tiles, items, races and classes, for one made for this universe

editor.tag.disabled.description: Under an area in the list of areas, or in the last column of the editor's tables of items, races and classes, for one players can't use: an area they can't go into, an item characters can't be given, or a race or class new characters can't choose

editor.tag.edited.description: In the last column of the editor's tables of tiles, items, races and classes, for one of the ruleset's that this universe changed

editor.theme.ability.description: Label of the field for the ability score a theme raises

editor.theme.abilityHint.defaultMessage: Characters with the theme get +{bonus, number} to this ability.
editor.theme.abilityHint.description: Explains the theme editor's Ability raised field; {bonus} is how much the ability score goes up

editor.theme.addTitle.description: Title of the theme editor when making a new theme (a character background, such as ace pilot)

editor.theme.delete.description: Button in the theme editor that deletes a theme made for this universe

editor.theme.editTitle.description: Title of the theme editor for a theme the player can change; {theme} is its name, e.g. Ace Pilot

editor.theme.enabledHint.defaultMessage: New characters can only choose enabled themes, and at least one theme must be enabled.
editor.theme.enabledHint.description: Explains the theme editor's Enabled checkbox

editor.themes.ability.description: A theme's summary in the list of themes on the editor's Characters tab: the ability it raises and by how much, e.g. Dexterity +1; {ability} is the ability's name

editor.themes.add.description: Button that opens the dialog for making a new theme (a character background, such as ace pilot)

editor.themes.heading.description: Heading of the part of the editor's Characters tab listing the themes characters can have in Starfinder: backgrounds such as ace pilot or scholar

editor.themes.hint.defaultMessage: The themes new characters can choose: a background, such as a pilot or a scholar, that raises one ability score.
editor.themes.hint.description: Explains the themes on the editor's Characters tab, in Starfinder: a theme is a character's background, such as ace pilot or scholar

editor.themes.listFailed.description: Shown on the editor's Characters tab when the themes (character backgrounds, such as ace pilot) couldn't be loaded

editor.tile.addTitle.description: Title of the tile editor when making a new tile

editor.tile.color.description: The color a tile is drawn in: the label of its field in the tile editor, and the heading of the Tilesets table's column of colors

editor.tile.colorHex.description: Name of the field for a tile's color as a hexadecimal number, for screen readers

editor.tile.colorPicker.description: Name of the color picker for a tile's color, for screen readers

editor.tile.day.description: Caption of the preview of the tile in daylight

editor.tile.delete.description: Button in the tile editor that deletes a tile made for this universe

editor.tile.deleteGraphic.description: Button in the tile editor, shown when an uploaded tileset is chosen, that marks that uploaded picture to delete, after asking; tiles drawn with it go back to their colors

editor.tile.deleteGraphicConfirm.defaultMessage: Delete the uploaded tileset "{name}"? Every tile drawn with it will be drawn in its color instead.
editor.tile.deleteGraphicConfirm.description: Asked before marking an uploaded tileset (a picture tiles can be drawn with) to delete from the tile editor; {name} is the name it was given. Nothing is deleted until the tab is saved

editor.tile.editTitle.description: Title of the tile editor for a tile the player can change; {tile} is its name

editor.tile.graphic.description: Label of the tile editor's list of the graphics a tile can be drawn with

editor.tile.graphic.forest.description: One of the graphics a tile can be drawn with, in the tile editor's list of them and read out for the Tilesets table's pictures of tiles: woodland

editor.tile.graphic.grass.description: One of the graphics a tile can be drawn with, in the tile editor's list of them and read out for the Tilesets table's pictures of tiles: grass

editor.tile.graphic.mountains.description: One of the graphics a tile can be drawn with, in the tile editor's list of them and read out for the Tilesets table's pictures of tiles: mountains, whose peaks are drawn over players standing just north of them when the tile can't be entered

editor.tile.graphicHint.defaultMessage: Drawn in place of the color. Where tiles meet, their edges blend.
editor.tile.graphicHint.description: Explains the tile editor's list of graphics

editor.tile.invalidColor.defaultMessage: Enter a hex color, such as #7AFF3D.
editor.tile.invalidColor.description: Shown by the color field when what was typed isn't a hexadecimal color

editor.tile.night.description: Caption of the preview of the tile at night

editor.tile.noGraphic.description: First choice in the tile editor's list of graphics: the tile is drawn in its color

editor.tile.uploadGraphic.description: Button in the tile editor that opens the dialog for uploading a tileset (a picture a tile can be drawn with)

editor.tile.uploadedGraphic.description: A tileset this universe's editors uploaded, in the tile editor's list of graphics; {name} is the name it was given. "custom" marks it as made for this universe rather than coming with the game, as the editor tags custom tiles and items

editor.tile.usedIn.description: Heading of whether indoor areas, outdoor areas, both or neither can paint with a tile: in the tile editor, and the Tilesets tab's filter and table column

editor.tile.usedInHint.defaultMessage: Areas can only paint with tiles for their kind. A tile for neither can't be painted, but maps that already use it keep it.
editor.tile.usedInHint.description: Explains the checkboxes for whether indoor areas, outdoor areas, both or neither can paint with a tile

editor.tile.visionCost.description: Label of the field for how much of a character's vision crossing the tile uses, in percent

editor.tile.walkHint.defaultMessage: Game time walking a square takes. 10 is normal indoors and 600 (10 minutes) outdoors, twice that takes twice as long, and 0 can't be entered.

editor.tile.walkImpassable.description: Under the walk time field of the tile editor when it is 0, which makes the tile impassable

editor.tile.walkSeconds.description: Label of the field for how many seconds of game time walking a square of the tile takes

editor.tileDelete.checkFailed.defaultMessage: Could not find out which maps use the tile.
editor.tileDelete.checkFailed.description: Shown in the dialog before deleting a tile when the areas using it couldn't be loaded

editor.tileDelete.checking.description: Shown in the dialog before deleting a tile while it finds out which areas' maps use the tile

editor.tileDelete.chooseReplacement.description: First choice in the list of tiles to replace a tile being deleted, before one is chosen

editor.tileDelete.question.defaultMessage: Delete the tile "{name}" when the Tilesets tab is saved?
editor.tileDelete.question.description: Asked in the dialog before deleting a tile; {name} is the tile's name. Nothing is deleted until the tab is saved

editor.tileDelete.replaceWith.description: Label of the list of tiles to paint the maps with in place of a tile being deleted

editor.tileDelete.submit.description: Button in the dialog that asks before deleting a tile: marks the tile to delete when the Tilesets tab is saved

editor.tileDelete.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting a tile

editor.tileDelete.usage.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {The map of {areas} uses it.} other {The maps of {areas} use it.}} Choose a tile to paint {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} with in its place.
editor.tileDelete.usage.description: Shown in the dialog before deleting a tile that maps use; {areas} lists the areas' names, and {count} is how many there are

editor.tileGraphic.drawOrder.description: Label of the field for a tileset's draw order: a number deciding whose edges are drawn on top where two kinds of tile meet

editor.tileGraphic.drawOrderExample.description: One of the game's own tilesets with its draw order, in the list under the draw order field, e.g. "Grass 30"

editor.tileGraphic.drawOrderHint.defaultMessage: Where two kinds of tile meet, the higher number's edges are drawn over the other's. The tilesets that come with the game are {orders}.
editor.tileGraphic.drawOrderHint.description: Explains the draw order field of the tileset upload dialog; {orders} lists the game's own tilesets with their numbers, e.g. "Grass 30, Forest 40 and Mountains 50"

editor.tileGraphic.file.description: Label of the field for choosing the picture file of a tileset to upload

editor.tileGraphic.formatHint.defaultMessage: A PNG of {size, number} by {size, number} pixels, at most {kilobytes, number} KB: {columns, number} frames across and {columns, number} down in the Dual-Grid layout.
editor.tileGraphic.formatHint.description: Explains what picture a tileset upload needs; {size} is its width and height in pixels, {kilobytes} the largest file allowed, and {columns} how many frames it has across and down

editor.tileGraphic.rights.defaultMessage: I have the rights to use this image
editor.tileGraphic.rights.description: Checkbox that must be ticked to upload a picture: the uploader confirms they made it, own it or have permission to use it

editor.tileGraphic.submit.description: Button that adds the chosen tileset to the Tilesets tab's changes; it is uploaded when the tab is saved

editor.tileGraphic.title.description: Title of the dialog for uploading a tileset: a picture of a terrain that tiles can be drawn with

editor.tileGraphic.unreadable.description: Shown in the tileset upload dialog when the chosen file couldn't be opened as a picture

editor.tileGraphicDelete.submit.description: Button in the dialog that asks before deleting an uploaded tileset: marks it to delete when the Tilesets tab is saved

editor.tileGraphicDelete.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting an uploaded tileset (a picture tiles can be drawn with)

editor.tiles.add.description: Button that opens the dialog for making a new tile

editor.tiles.deleteUploadFailed.description: Shown on the Tilesets tab when saving couldn't delete an uploaded tileset; {name} is the name it was given

editor.tiles.impassable.description: In the walk time column, for a tile that can't be walked into

editor.tiles.listFailed.description: Shown on the Tilesets tab when the tiles couldn't be loaded

editor.tiles.none.description: Shown instead of the table when no tile matches the filters

editor.tiles.passable.description: Label of the filter for whether a tile can be walked onto

editor.tiles.percent.description: A tile's vision cost as a percentage, e.g. 50%. Change only for a language whose percentages the number format gets wrong

editor.tiles.searchLabel.description: Name of the field that filters the tiles by name, for screen readers

editor.tiles.uploadFailed.description: Shown on the Tilesets tab when saving couldn't upload a tileset; {name} is the name it was given

editor.tiles.uploadsFailed.defaultMessage: Could not list the uploaded tilesets.
editor.tiles.uploadsFailed.description: Shown on the Tilesets tab when the tilesets the universe's editors uploaded couldn't be loaded

editor.tiles.usedInValue.description: Whether indoor areas only, outdoor areas only, both or neither can paint with a tile: in the Where column and as the choices of the Where filter

editor.tiles.visionCost.description: Heading of the table column with how much of a character's vision crossing each tile uses

editor.tiles.walkTime.description: Heading of the table column with how many seconds of game time walking a square of each tile takes

editor.title.description: Heading of the world editor until the universe's name has loaded

editor.universe.longDescription.description: Label of the field for a universe's full description, which is written in Markdown

editor.universe.preview.description: Heading above the long description as players will see it

editor.universe.saveFailed.description: Shown on the Universe tab when its settings couldn't be stored

editor.universe.stage.description: Heading of the choice of how far along a universe is, from being built to being retired

editor.universeTitle.description: Heading of the world editor, linking to the editor's first tab; {universe} is the universe's name

error.alreadyInGroup.defaultMessage: That character is already in a group. They have to leave it first.
error.alreadyInGroup.description: Why a character couldn't make or join a group: a character can be in only one group at a time

error.areaInsideItself.defaultMessage: An area can't be inside itself.
error.areaInsideItself.description: Why an area's settings were refused: the parent chosen is the area itself or an area inside it

error.areaLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}}.
error.areaLimit.description: Why a new area wasn't made: the universe has as many areas as allowed

error.cantDeleteArea.defaultMessage: The lobby and starting areas can't be deleted.
error.cantDeleteArea.description: Why an area couldn't be deleted: the universe needs it

error.cellOutOfBounds.defaultMessage: Every cell must be inside the area's map.
error.cellOutOfBounds.description: Why painting was refused: some cells are outside the map, perhaps because another editor made it smaller

error.characterLimit.defaultMessage: You can have at most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} in a universe.
error.characterLimit.description: Why a new character wasn't made: the player has as many characters in this universe as allowed

error.classInUse.defaultMessage: Characters are this class, so it can't be deleted. Disable it instead.
error.classInUse.description: Why a character class the universe added couldn't be deleted: players have made characters of it; disabling it only stops new characters choosing it

error.classLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# class} other {# classes}} of its own.
error.classLimit.description: Why a new character class wasn't made: the universe has as many classes of its own as allowed

error.classNeedsName.description: Why a character class the universe added couldn't be saved: its name was left out

error.classUnavailable.defaultMessage: That class can't be chosen any more. Choose another.
error.classUnavailable.description: Why a new character wasn't made: the class chosen was deleted or disabled while the player was making the character

error.deleteGroupMember.defaultMessage: That character is in a group. They have to leave it before they can be deleted.
error.deleteGroupMember.description: Why a character wasn't deleted, straight away or after some days: characters in a group can't be deleted

error.difficultyLevelLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# difficulty level} other {# difficulty levels}}.
error.difficultyLevelLimit.description: Why a new difficulty level wasn't made: the universe has as many as allowed

error.difficultyLevelNeedsDefault.defaultMessage: A universe needs a default difficulty level. Make another level the default instead.
error.difficultyLevelNeedsDefault.description: Why the default difficulty level couldn't be deleted or stop being the default: exactly one level is always the default, so another one has to be made the default

error.difficultyLevelNeedsName.defaultMessage: A difficulty level needs a name.
error.difficultyLevelNeedsName.description: Why a difficulty level the universe added couldn't be saved: its name was left out

error.faerieCantLoop.defaultMessage: An area whose passage of time is faerie can't loop.
error.faerieCantLoop.description: Why an area can't both have faerie time and a map that wraps around: shown by the area editor's loop checkboxes, and as the reason the server refused an area's settings

error.faerieLobbyCantLoop.defaultMessage: The lobby's passage of time can't be faerie while its map loops.
error.faerieLobbyCantLoop.description: Why the lobby's settings, or its area's, were refused: faerie time and a map that wraps around can't be combined

error.faerieMorningMismatch.defaultMessage: Where morning is must be chosen when, and only when, the passage of time is faerie.
error.faerieMorningMismatch.description: Why time settings were refused: "where is morning?" was given without faerie time, or left out with it

error.floatingAbility.defaultMessage: Choose the ability that gets the race's bonus, and only for a race that has one.
error.floatingAbility.description: Why a new character wasn't made: a race that lets the player choose an ability to raise had none chosen, or another race had one

error.groupCharacterUnavailable.defaultMessage: That character can't do that: they don't exist, aren't yours, or have been given their last rites.
error.groupCharacterUnavailable.description: Why a character couldn't make, join or leave a group: the character isn't one of the player's in this universe, or is waiting to be deleted

error.groupFull.defaultMessage: The group is full: it already has {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
error.groupFull.description: Why a character couldn't join a group with an invite link; {max} is the most characters the universe allows in a group

error.invalidRequest.description: Why the server refused a request the page should never send; {problem} is a technical description in English

error.invalidScores.defaultMessage: The ability scores aren't allowed: use each rolled score once, or stay within the points you can spend.
error.invalidScores.description: Why a new character wasn't made: the ability scores sent weren't the rolled ones, or cost more points than allowed

error.inviteGone.defaultMessage: This invite link has expired, has already been used, or is wrong.
error.inviteGone.description: Why an invite link to a group didn't work

error.itemCarried.defaultMessage: Characters carry this item, so it can't be deleted. Disable it instead.
error.itemCarried.description: Why an item the universe added couldn't be deleted: players' characters have it; disabling it only stops new characters being given it

error.itemInStartingEquipment.defaultMessage: Characters start with this item, so it can't be deleted. Take it out of the starting equipment of the universe and of every race and class first.
error.itemInStartingEquipment.description: Why an item couldn't be deleted: it is in the equipment characters of the universe, or of one of its races or classes, start with

error.itemLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} of its own.
error.itemLimit.description: Why a new item wasn't made: the universe has as many items of its own as allowed

error.itemNeedsName.description: Why an item the universe added couldn't be saved: its name was left out

error.lastRitesOff.defaultMessage: Characters can't be given their last rites on this site. They can only be deleted straight away.
error.lastRitesOff.description: Why a character wasn't given their last rites (deleted after some days): the site's settings have turned waiting off

error.linkOutOfBounds.defaultMessage: The link's cell must be inside the area's map.
error.linkOutOfBounds.description: Why an area link was refused: its cell is outside the map, perhaps because another editor made it smaller

error.linkTargetNotInUniverse.defaultMessage: A link must go to another area of this universe.
error.linkTargetNotInUniverse.description: Why an area link was refused: the area it leads to doesn't exist or is in another universe

error.linkTargetOutOfBounds.defaultMessage: Where the link goes must be inside the other area's map.
error.linkTargetOutOfBounds.description: Why an area link was refused: the cell it leads to is outside the other area's map

error.linkToSameArea.defaultMessage: A link must go to another area.
error.linkToSameArea.description: Why an area link was refused: it leads to the area it is in

error.logInFirst.description: Why an editor request was refused: the browser isn't logged in

error.noEnabledClass.defaultMessage: A universe needs at least one enabled class, so new characters have one to be.
error.noEnabledClass.description: Why a character class couldn't be disabled or deleted: it is the last class new characters can choose

error.noEnabledRace.defaultMessage: A universe needs at least one enabled race, so new characters have one to be.
error.noEnabledRace.description: Why a race couldn't be disabled or deleted: it is the last race new characters can choose

error.noEnabledTheme.defaultMessage: A universe needs at least one enabled theme, so new characters have one to choose.
error.noEnabledTheme.description: Why a theme couldn't be disabled or deleted: it is the last theme new characters can choose

error.noSuchArea.description: Why a request about an area failed: it was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.noSuchCharacter.defaultMessage: The character doesn't exist, or isn't yours.
error.noSuchCharacter.description: Why a character's sheet couldn't be shown: the character isn't one of the player's in this universe

error.noSuchClass.description: Why a request about a character class (such as fighter or wizard) failed: it was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.noSuchDifficultyLevel.defaultMessage: That difficulty doesn't exist any more. Choose another.
error.noSuchDifficultyLevel.description: Why a group wasn't made: the difficulty level chosen for it was deleted by the universe's creators, perhaps while the player was choosing

error.noSuchDifficultyLevelToEdit.description: Why a request about a difficulty level failed: it was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.noSuchGroup.defaultMessage: The group doesn't exist any more, or that character isn't in it.
error.noSuchGroup.description: Why a character couldn't leave a group or an invite link couldn't be made: the group was disbanded, or the character had already left

error.noSuchItem.description: Why a request about an item failed: it was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.noSuchLink.defaultMessage: There is no link on that cell.
error.noSuchLink.description: Why an area link couldn't be deleted: it was already gone, perhaps deleted by another editor

error.noSuchRace.description: Why a request about a race (such as elf or dwarf) failed: it was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.noSuchReplacementTile.defaultMessage: The tile chosen to replace it doesn't exist.
error.noSuchReplacementTile.description: Why a tile couldn't be deleted: the tile chosen to paint the maps with in its place isn't one of the universe's tiles, perhaps because it was deleted

error.noSuchTheme.description: Why a request about a theme (a character background, such as ace pilot or scholar) failed: it was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.noSuchTile.description: Why a request about a tile failed: it was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.noSuchTileGraphic.description: Why an uploaded tileset couldn't be loaded: there is none with that address

error.noSuchUniverse.defaultMessage: The universe doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
error.noSuchUniverse.description: Why a request about a universe failed: it was deleted, or the player has no access to it

error.noSuchUploadedGraphic.defaultMessage: The uploaded tileset doesn't exist in this universe.
error.noSuchUploadedGraphic.description: Why a tile couldn't be saved: the uploaded tileset chosen for it isn't one of this universe's

error.noSuchUploadedGraphicToDelete.defaultMessage: The uploaded tileset doesn't exist. It may have been deleted already.
error.noSuchUploadedGraphicToDelete.description: Why an uploaded tileset couldn't be deleted: there is no such tileset in this universe, perhaps because another editor deleted it

error.noThemes.defaultMessage: This universe's ruleset has no themes.
error.noThemes.description: Why a request about themes (character backgrounds, such as ace pilot or scholar) failed: the universe's game rules don't use them

error.onlyAnchorInvites.defaultMessage: Only the anchor being's player can invite others to the group.
error.onlyAnchorInvites.description: Why an invite link wasn't made: only the player of the character the group is centered on (its "anchor being") may make one

error.otherOrigin.defaultMessage: Changes aren't allowed from this website.
error.otherOrigin.description: Why an editor change was refused: it came from a page on another website

error.parentNotInUniverse.defaultMessage: The parent area must be an area of this universe.
error.parentNotInUniverse.description: Why an area's settings were refused: the area chosen to hold it doesn't exist

error.raceInUse.defaultMessage: Characters are this race, so it can't be deleted. Disable it instead.
error.raceInUse.description: Why a race the universe added couldn't be deleted: players have made characters of it; disabling it only stops new characters choosing it

error.raceLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# race} other {# races}} of its own.
error.raceLimit.description: Why a new race wasn't made: the universe has as many races of its own as allowed

error.raceNeedsName.description: Why a race the universe added couldn't be saved: its name was left out

error.raceUnavailable.defaultMessage: That race can't be chosen any more. Choose another.
error.raceUnavailable.description: Why a new character wasn't made: the race chosen was deleted or disabled while the player was making the character

error.resizeDiscards.defaultMessage: Resizing would discard painted cells or links.
error.resizeDiscards.description: Why a map wasn't made smaller without asking: the part it would lose has painting or links

error.roleNotAllowed.defaultMessage: Your role in this universe doesn't allow that.
error.roleNotAllowed.description: Why an editor change was refused: the player's role, such as beta tester, can't make it

error.scoresChanged.defaultMessage: The universe has changed how ability scores are made. Close Create Character and open it again.
error.scoresChanged.description: Why a new character wasn't made: the universe's editor changed between rolling and buying ability scores, or how they are rolled, while the player was making the character

error.somethingWentWrong.defaultMessage: Something went wrong on the server.
error.somethingWentWrong.description: Why a request failed when the server had an unexpected problem

error.themeInUse.defaultMessage: Characters have this theme, so it can't be deleted. Disable it instead.
error.themeInUse.description: Why a theme the universe added couldn't be deleted: players have made characters with it; disabling it only stops new characters choosing it

error.themeLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# theme} other {# themes}} of its own.
error.themeLimit.description: Why a new theme (character background) wasn't made: the universe has as many themes of its own as allowed

error.themeNeedsName.description: Why a theme the universe added couldn't be saved: its name was left out

error.themeUnavailable.defaultMessage: That theme can't be chosen any more. Choose another.
error.themeUnavailable.description: Why a new character wasn't made: the theme (character background, such as ace pilot) chosen was deleted or disabled while the player was making the character, or none was chosen

error.tileGraphicLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# uploaded tileset} other {# uploaded tilesets}}.
error.tileGraphicLimit.description: Why a tileset wasn't uploaded: the universe has as many uploaded tilesets as allowed

error.tileGraphicNotPng.defaultMessage: The file isn't a PNG image.
error.tileGraphicNotPng.description: Why an uploaded tileset was refused: it isn't a PNG picture, or is damaged

error.tileGraphicTooLarge.defaultMessage: The image can be at most {max, number} KB.
error.tileGraphicTooLarge.description: Why an uploaded tileset was refused: the file is too big; {max} is the most it can be, in kilobytes

error.tileGraphicWrongSize.defaultMessage: A tileset must be {size, number} by {size, number} pixels.
error.tileGraphicWrongSize.description: Why an uploaded tileset was refused: the picture is the wrong size; {size} is its width and height in pixels

error.tileInUse.defaultMessage: A map uses this tile, so it can't be deleted.
error.tileInUse.description: Why a tile couldn't be deleted: some area's map is painted with it

error.tileLimit.defaultMessage: A universe can have at most {max, plural, one {# tile} other {# tiles}} of its own.
error.tileLimit.description: Why a new tile wasn't made: the universe has as many tiles of its own as allowed

error.tileNeedsName.description: Why a tile the universe added couldn't be saved: its name was left out

error.universeCreationDisabled.defaultMessage: Creating universes is turned off for now.
error.universeCreationDisabled.description: Why a new universe wasn't made: the site's admins have stopped everyone from creating universes

error.universeLimit.defaultMessage: You can create at most {max, plural, one {# universe} other {# universes}}.
error.universeLimit.description: Why a new universe wasn't made: the player has made as many as allowed

error.universeNameTaken.defaultMessage: Another universe already has that name, or one too much like it.
error.universeNameTaken.description: Why a universe wasn't made or renamed: universe names must be unique, and names that could be mistaken for each other count as the same, such as ones that differ only in capitals, accents, spaces or punctuation, letters from another alphabet that look the same, or "1" for "i"

error.unknownItemType.defaultMessage: The universe's ruleset has no such type of item.
error.unknownItemType.description: Why an item couldn't be saved: the type chosen for it isn't one of the game rules' item types

error.unknownRaceArea.defaultMessage: A starting area is chosen for a race this universe doesn't have.
error.unknownRaceArea.description: Why a character class's settings were refused: one of its areas for a race is for a race that was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.unreadableBody.defaultMessage: The request could not be read.
error.unreadableBody.description: Why the server refused a request whose contents were damaged or too large

error.unusableDefaultTile.defaultMessage: The default tile must be a tile this universe can use.
error.unusableDefaultTile.description: Why an area's settings were refused: the default tile was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.unusableStartingArea.defaultMessage: The starting area must be an area of this universe other than the lobby.
error.unusableStartingArea.description: Why a starting area (the universe's, a race's or a class's) was refused: the area chosen for characters to start in is the lobby, or was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.unusableStartingItem.defaultMessage: The starting equipment holds an item this universe doesn't have.
error.unusableStartingItem.description: Why starting equipment (the universe's, a race's or a class's) was refused: one of its items was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.unusableTile.defaultMessage: One of the tiles painted isn't one this universe can use.
error.unusableTile.description: Why painting was refused: a tile was deleted, perhaps by another editor

error.wrongRuleset.defaultMessage: These settings are for a different ruleset than the universe's.
error.wrongRuleset.description: Why a universe's ruleset settings were refused: they were made for another set of game rules

filter.any.description: Choice of a filter on the Items or Tilesets tab that shows everything, such as items of every type, or tiles whether passable or not

filter.no.description: Choice of a yes-or-no filter on the Items or Tilesets tab, e.g. Passable: No

filter.yes.description: Choice of a yes-or-no filter on the Items or Tilesets tab, e.g. Passable: Yes
